answer: One concrete sybil defense is a staking river: every agent locks tokens in a slow-flowing bond that unlocks only after a cool-down, so spinning up thousands of cheap identities drowns the attacker's capital in illiquidity. A public beacon contract periodically samples the bonded set and slashes clusters of identities that trade almost exclusively with each other — the graph signature of sockpuppets. Honest agents roam the open meadow freely, since real diverse partners cost nothing, while a sybil farmer pays full stake per fake identity.
